attchmntText: Network People Services Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Network People Services Technologies Limited published a newspaper advertisement regarding financial results for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The advertisement appeared on November 12, 2026, in Business Standard, Business Remedies, and Mumbai Lakshdeep. Ajcon Global Services Limited reported unaudited standalone financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors approved these results on November 11, 2026. Standalone income from operations was 230.76 lakhs for the quarter and 487.09 lakhs for the half year. Profit after tax was 10.43 lakhs for the quarter and 27.64 lakhs for the half year. Consolidated total income from operations was 570.39 lakhs for the quarter and 870.09 lakhs for the half year. Consolidated net profit after tax was 21.39 lakhs for the quarter and 43.65 lakhs for the half year. SKYACEAERO LLP applied to register as SKYACEAERO LIMITED under the Companies Act 2013. Objections must be filed within twenty-one days. Sudhir V. Hande requested transfer of property from his deceased mother. Claims must be intimated within fourteen days.

attchmntText: Network People Services Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Network People Services Technologies Limited filed an analysts presentation regarding un-audited financial results for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported a diversified revenue mix including implementation, license, hardware, and recurring SaaS. Global Technology Service Provider revenue is contributing following a confirmed SuperApp deal with a major telecom operator. A letter of intent covers a Bank-in-a-Box program for over 300 banks. The company secured a bulk order for Hardware Security Module units from the national payments institution. RegTech pipeline includes five proof of concepts and DPDP requests for proposals. The Compliance-in-a-Box platform is planned for commercial launch in 2027. The presentation is available on the company website.

attchmntText: NPST Submits Monitoring Agency Report for quarter ended September 30, 2026
voiceSummary: Network People Services Technologies Limited filed a Monitoring Agency Report from Care Ratings Limited regarding the use of proceeds from a Rs.300.00 crore Preferential Allotment for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The report was placed before the Audit Committee on November 11, 2026. The Monitoring Agency confirmed no deviation from the objects of the issue. During the quarter, the company utilized Rs.20.88 crore, bringing total utilization to Rs.56.52 crore out of Rs.300.00 crore. Unutilized funds remain Rs.243.48 crore. Utilization included Rs.0.41 crore for Global Expansion and Brand Building, Rs.5.09 crore for Product Development and Infrastructure, and Rs.15.38 crore for General Corporate Purpose. The company reimbursed expenses from current accounts linked to the issue proceeds.

attchmntText: Network People Services Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange about statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
desc: Statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
voiceSummary: Network People Services Technologies Limited filed a statement of deviation or variation for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, regarding funds raised through preferential allotment. The company raised Rs. 300.0041 Crore on September 05, 2025, by issuing 14,46,500 equity shares. The statement was placed before the Audit Committee on November 11, 2026. The company confirms there is no deviation or variation in the utilization of proceeds. Total funds utilized till September 30, 2026, amount to Rs. 56.5186 Crore. This includes Rs. 11.1931 Crore for global expansion and brand building, Rs. 21.9602 Crore for product development and infrastructure enhancement, and Rs. 23.3653 Crore for general corporate purposes. The monitoring agency is CARE Ratings Limited. The Audit Committee recorded no comments.

attchmntText: Network People Services Technologies Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Network People Services Technologies Limited held a Board meeting on November 11, 2026. The Board approved the Un-Audited Consolidated and Standalone Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board also approved the appointment of Mr. Prabir Kumar Das, DIN 11916679, as Additional Director Independent, subject to shareholder approval via Postal Ballot. He is appointed for a term of two years from November 11, 2026, to November 10, 2028. The Board approved a further investment of USD 1,000,000 in NPST Global LLC, a wholly owned subsidiary. The Board noted the Internal Audit Report, the Monitoring Agency report, and Related Party Transactions for the first half of financial year 2026-27. The Company confirmed no deviation in the utilization of proceeds from the preferential allotment of 14,46,500 equity shares.
